title: Detailed avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow under avocado -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#2e4a2a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- outer skin (dark green) -->
  <path d='M50 8 C70 8 86 34 86 58 C86 80 70 93 50 93 C30 93 14 80 14 58 C14 34 30 8 50 8 Z' fill='#2f5d24'/>
  <!-- skin highlight edge -->
  <path d='M50 8 C70 8 86 34 86 58 C86 80 70 93 50 93 C30 93 14 80 14 58 C14 34 30 8 50 8 Z' fill='none' stroke='#4a8a38' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- bumpy texture dots on skin -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='62' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='72' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='66' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='86' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='86' r='1.6' fill='#4a8a38'/>
  <!-- inner flesh (light green) -->
  <path d='M50 18 C66 18 79 38 79 58 C79 76 66 87 50 87 C34 87 21 76 21 58 C21 38 34 18 50 18 Z' fill='#c8e06a'/>
  <!-- flesh inner ring shading -->
  <path d='M50 18 C66 18 79 38 79 58 C79 76 66 87 50 87 C34 87 21 76 21 58 C21 38 34 18 50 18 Z' fill='none' stroke='#a8c84c' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- creamy inner gradient shading -->
  <path d='M50 26 C62 26 72 42 72 58 C72 72 62 81 50 81 C38 81 28 72 28 58 C28 42 38 26 50 26 Z' fill='#e8f5a0'/>
  <!-- pit (brown, glossy) -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='13' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#7a3b1a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- pit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='55' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#d98a55'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='54' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#f0c090'/>
  <!-- pit shading -->
  <path d='M52 70 C56 68 60 64 61 59' stroke='#7a3b1a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
